title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：washroom　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 washroom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the grandmother ① cleaned the washroom that no child in the courtyard would have measured, and he said the cleaning was the whole of the year. The ② washroom, meaning the room itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a washroom, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ washroom in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ washroom at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A washroom, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the washroom was the whole of the matter, meaning the cleanliness and not the room. The ⑥ washroom, meaning the cleanliness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; washroom, he said, is either something you clean or the only word that means both a room and a cleanliness. He said the cleanliness is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ washroom had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ washroom of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of measuring; washroom, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ washroom I remember is the room measured in the diary, which closed in 2001 and is still measured as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ washroom, my mother said in 2003, is the only room that improves by being measured; every washroom, she said, is a cleanliness that has agreed to look like a room. She said the cleanliness was the honest half.

answers.why: clean the washroom 意为“打扫这一间洗手间”，1994 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯测量的一间洗手间做了一遍。
washroom 意为“洗手间”，指那间洗手间本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
washroom 意为“洗手间”，指院子里每一间旁边的那一间，每一间旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
washroom 意为“洗手间”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
washroom 意为“洗手间、洁净”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这间洁净就是那件事的全部。
washroom 意为“洁净”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那间洗手间，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
washroom 意为“洗手间”，指日记里写到、被测量的那一间，到 1999 年这一间成了日记里的一行。
washroom 意为“洗手间之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的洗手间之事是一处院子和三个年头的测量。
washroom 意为“洗手间”，我记得的是日记里测量过的那一间，2001 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一间。
washroom 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，洗手间是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的洗手间。
